ideas.pitch: An interactive execution visualizer for algorithmic problem solving that traces hidden test cases and highlights data structure mutations in real-time.
ideas.title: AlgoTrace Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the core evaluation of algorithmic problem-solving and efficiency by giving candidates a tool to debug hidden test case failures instantly.

ideas.pitch: An automated domain-based MCQ and flashcard generator that parses computer science textbooks to create targeted tests for programming fundamentals.
ideas.title: CS-Concept Synthesizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the domain-based MCQs and programming language concepts tested in the technical assessment structure.

ideas.pitch: An offline code analysis utility that evaluates Python and C++ solutions for time and space complexity bottlenecks before submission.
ideas.title: ComplexityOptimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact constraint of code efficiency evaluation against hidden test cases without relying on slow external APIs.

ideas.pitch: A sandboxed environment designed for solo developers to test custom implementations of complex data structures under strict time and memory limits.
ideas.title: DataStruct Playground
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the solo assessment format and directly addresses the requirement for rigorous testing of core computer science fundamentals.

ideas.pitch: A language-specific code reasoner that flags subtle runtime errors and edge-case bugs common in technical online assessments.
ideas.title: SyntaxGuard AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages code reasoning evaluation patterns to help solo candidates eliminate silly syntax and logic mistakes under time pressure.
